title: Decision Stump with Gini Impurity
learning_objectives: Search thresholds at midpoints between sorted unique values
Choose the split with the lowest weighted impurity
hints: `_, counts = np.unique(y, return_counts=True); p = counts / len(y); 1 - (p**2).sum()`.
Use strict `<` when comparing impurities so the first (lowest feature/threshold) best is kept.

failure_feedback.advice: Weight each child's Gini by its share of samples.
Thresholds are midpoints between consecutive *unique* values.
Only replace the best split when strictly better.
Gini = 1 − Σ p_c²; return 0 for empty input.
